podcast.body: The album artwork, designed by Hipgnosis, features a mysterious black obelisk that a family is staring at, leaving its meaning open to interpretation. "What's that black obelisk that the family is staring at on the cover of Led Zeppelin's presence album?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The album cover for "Presence" was designed by Storm Thorgerson, a highly acclaimed album art creator. His distinctive visual style contributed significantly to the aesthetic of this and many other iconic rock albums. "The Led Zeppelin logo, along with the album's presence... came from Thorgerson."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Stories Behind Iconic Album Covers Part 2
